result.evidence: 0:00-0:28: The lesson opens with a real-world scenario (drone network) and a clear question ('How do edges talk to edges?'). 1:16-2:48: The manual, step-by-step construction of the edge graph is highly repetitive, creating a noticeable lull in momentum. 2:48-3:59: The interactive degree calculation and the node/edge toggle view provide engaging visual variety and moments of insight. 3:59-4:31: Concludes with a quick quiz.
result.score_reason: The lesson fully meets level 5. It features an opening with a clear stake, good variety (animations, interactive-style demos, quiz), and moments of insight. It falls short of level 6 because the repetitive graph construction sequence creates lulls that are more than brief.
